prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 landing-page background for Letterbox, a personal digital letter website. Primary request: soft nostalgic lo-fi countryside village at dusk with vintage Disney-inspired hand-painted animated storybook background charm, watercolor and gouache on aged paper, rounded organic shapes, slightly crooked quaint architecture and delicate visible brushwork. Scene: a quiet winding village lane, a small weathered letterbox beside a garden gate near the left edge with climbing flowers, distant modest cottages with a few softly glowing amber windows, rounded trees and soft foliage framing outer edges. No people or characters. Composition: wide landscape 16:9; detail concentrated at lower left and far right edges; central 55% open pale misty sky and softly blurred distant landscape, even gentle low contrast for dark headline text and buttons to overlay; horizon in lower third. Main letterbox fully visible within left quarter with breathing room, no readable writing on it. Color palette overall soft faded warm cream, dusty sage, pale peach, muted blue-gray, small restrained amber window lights, no vivid saturation. Lighting: gentle diffuse dusk, luminous haze, dreamy calm and inviting warmth. Texture: fine analog grain and subtle old paper texture, hand-painted rather than photographic or 3D. Constraints: one standalone high-resolution background image; no text, typography, logos, watermark, border, UI elements, harsh shadows or strong bright sun. Keep center quiet and usable for webpage content.
